settings.copy: Atelier Meridian is a full-service interior design studio for people who want a home that works as hard as they do — and still feels like a refuge. We design, source, and build rooms that are calm, considered, and unmistakably yours.

settings.title: One studio,
settings.intro: From a single living room to a full home or a boutique hospitality space, we bring the same care to every square foot.

features.title: Residential design
features.text: Living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, and full homes — designed around how you live, not a magazine spread.

features.title: Hospitality & retail
features.text: Cafés, boutiques, and hotel lobbies that make people want to stay. We design for flow, comfort, and brand.

features.title: Furniture & sourcing
features.text: A curated network of makers and suppliers — from bespoke joinery to vintage finds — so every piece has a story.

features.title: Project management
features.text: One point of contact for every tradesperson, delivery, and deadline. You approve the big calls; we handle the rest.

features.title: Styling & staging
features.text: The final layer that makes a room feel finished — art, textiles, and objects placed with intention.

features.title: Renovation oversight
features.text: We work alongside your builder or architect to make sure the design intent survives the build.

settings.title: From blank room
settings.intro: A clear, four-step process that keeps you informed and in control — without the overwhelm of a hundred decisions at once.

steps.title: Listen & measure
steps.text: We walk your space, learn how you actually live, and pin down the budget and timeline. No assumptions, no templates — just a clear brief.

steps.title: Design & refine
steps.text: We develop a concept, moodboards, and a floor plan. You react, we refine, until the direction feels exactly right.

steps.title: Source & build
steps.text: We source furniture, finishes, and lighting, and manage every tradesperson. You approve the big calls; we handle the rest.

steps.title: Style & handover
steps.text: We style the final room, walk you through it, and hand over a home that's ready to live in — plus a care guide for the pieces.

settings.note: Most single-room projects run 8–12 weeks from first walkthrough to handover. We give you a firm timeline up front and stick to it.

settings.title: The feeling of
settings.intro: People tell us the same thing: the process felt calm, and the result felt like them. Here's a little of that.

reviews.quote: I was terrified of the whole thing — the budget, the decisions, the trades. Atelier Meridian made it feel easy. They listened, they pushed back when it mattered, and the room they handed over is the first one that's ever felt like mine.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.quote: They designed our café around how people actually move through a room, not how it looks in a photo. Six months in, the flow still works and the space still feels warm. That's the craft.
reviews.author: Marcus & Lena

reviews.quote: The garden studio is the room I write in every day. It's quiet, it's beautiful, and it was delivered on time and on budget. I've already asked them to do the main house.
reviews.author: Priya N.

settings.intro: Tell us about your space, your timeline, and your budget, and we'll come back with an honest sense of what's possible. No obligation, no hard sell.
